faq.q: Do I need the original password to unlock the sheet?
faq.a: No. {brand} inspects the OpenXML sheet definitions and removes the protection constraints directly, unlocking it without brute-forcing.

faq.q: Will my formulas and cell formatting be preserved?
faq.a: Yes! All cell values, calculations, formulas, charts, and styling remain 100% intact.

faq.q: Is my confidential spreadsheet uploaded to your servers?
faq.a: Never. All processing is executed locally in your browser. Your sensitive financial and personal data never leaves your device.

unlock-excel.name: Unlock Excel Workbook

faq.q: What is the difference between sheet lock and workbook lock?
faq.a: Sheet locks restrict editing individual cells, while workbook locks prevent adding, deleting, hiding, or renaming entire sheets.

faq.q: Which formats are supported?
faq.a: Supports modern Excel formats including XLSX, XLSM, XLTX, and XLTM.

faq.q: Can I merge different file formats like CSV and XLSX together?
faq.a: Yes! You can mix CSV, TSV, and XLSX files in a single merge operation.

faq.q: Is there a limit on how many files I can combine?
faq.a: There are no arbitrary server limits. Because processing occurs in your browser memory, you can merge dozens of spreadsheets seamlessly.

faq.q: How are the split files named?

faq.q: Are hidden sheets included in the split?
faq.a: Yes, every sheet tab inside the workbook is extracted and exported.
